blocks.prompt: 3. Find \(a_1\) for the arithmetic series: \(d = 8,\ n = 19,\ S_n = 1786\).
blocks.explanation:
Pichhle sawal mein hum jama nikal rahe the; is dafa jama diya hua hai aur pehli term poochhi gayi hai. Yani formula wohi, bas unknown badal gaya.
Diya kya hai? \(d = 8\), \(n = 19\), \(S_n = 1786\).
Find kya karna hai? Pehli term \(a_1\).
Plan: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\) mein values rakh kar ek simple equation banegi, usay solve karna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(d = 8\), \(n = 19\), \(S_{19} = 1786\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_1\).
Tareeqa: \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}[2a_1 + (n-1)d]\) mein chaar cheezein hain: \(S_n\), \(n\), \(a_1\), \(d\). In mein se teen maloom hain, sirf \(a_1\) nahi. Jab formula mein ek hi unknown bache to woh ek equation ban jata hai jo solve ho sakti hai.

Values rakhein
\[1786 = \dfrac{19}{2}[2a_1 + 18(8)]\]
\[1786 = \dfrac{19}{2}(2a_1 + 144)\]
Kyun: \(n - 1 = 18\), aur \(18 \times 8 = 144\). Left side par diya hua jama 1786 rakha.

Right side ko simplify karein
\[1786 = 19(a_1 + 72)\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar har cheez even hai, is liye \(\frac{1}{2}\) andar le gaye: \(\frac{2a_1}{2} = a_1\) aur \(\frac{144}{2} = 72\). Is tarah fraction khatam ho gaya aur equation saaf ho gayi.

\(a_1\) nikalein
\[a_1 + 72 = \dfrac{1786}{19} = 94\]
\[a_1 = 94 - 72 = 22\]
Kyun: Dono taraf 19 se divide kiya (\(19 \times 94 = 1786\)), phir 72 dono taraf se minus kiya. Equation solve karne ka usool: jo cheez unknown ke saath judi ho, usay ulta amal kar ke doosri taraf bhejo.
Dhyan dein: Pehle 72 minus kar ke baad mein 19 se divide karna ghalat hai; 19 poore bracket se multiply ho raha hai.

Tasdeeq
\[a_{19} = 22 + 18(8) = 166\]
\[S_{19} = \dfrac{19}{2}(22 + 166)\]
\[= \dfrac{19}{2}(188)\]
\[= 19 \times 94 = 1786 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(a_1 = 22\) le kar 19th term 166 bani, aur pehli + aakhri ke formula se jama dobara 1786 aaya, jo diya gaya tha. Is liye jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(a_1 = 22\)
Yani series 22, 30, 38, ..., 166 hai jis ka jama 1786 hai.
